title: Introduction & Setup
description: Next.js nima, nima uchun kerak va o'rnatish

blocks.text: **Next.js** — bu Vercel kompaniyasi tomonidan yaratilgan, React kutubxonasiga asoslangan to'liq (full-stack) veb-framework.

Sof React da faqat mijoz (Client-side) tomonida ishlaydigan ilovalar yoziladi (SPA). Next.js esa React ilovalariga Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG) va API yozish imkoniyatlarini qo'shib beradi. Bu SEO (qidiruv tizimlari) va tezlik uchun juda muhimdir.

items: **App Router:** Fayl tizimiga asoslangan zamonaviy routing.
**Server Components (RSC):** Komponentlar sukut bo'yicha serverda render bo'ladi (tezroq yuklanadi, JS hajmi kamayadi).
**Data Fetching:** Ma'lumotlarni keshga olish (Caching) va avtomatik yangilash (Revalidation).
**Optimallashtirish:** Rasm (Image), Shrift (Font) va Skriptlarni avtomatik optimallashtirish.
**API Routes:** Bitta loyiha ichida ham Frontend, ham Backend API yozish imkoniyati.

blocks.text: Next.js loyihasini boshlashning eng oson yo'li `create-next-app` buyrug'idan foydalanishdir. U barcha kerakli sozlamalarni avtomatik tayyorlab beradi.
Buyruqni ishga tushirganda terminal sizdan bir nechta savol so'raydi:

items: **Tailwind CSS ishlatasizmi?** -> Yes (Dizayn uchun ajoyib tanlov)
**`src/` papkasini ishlatasizmi?** -> Yes (Kodni toza saqlash uchun)
**App Router ishlatasizmi?** -> Yes (Yangi va eng kuchli arxitektura)

import { execSync } from "node:child_process"

const help = execSync("npx next --help", { encoding: "utf8" })
// faqat asosiy buyruqlar nomini chiqaramiz
const commands = help
  .split("\n")
  .filter((line) => /^  (build|dev|start|info|telemetry|typegen|upgrade) /.test(line))
  .map((line) => line.trim().split(/\s+/)[0])
console.log(commands.join(", "))
